purpose: Zener–Hollomon (Z) parameter formula, i.e. the temperature-compensated strain rate function, used to characterize the comprehensive influence of deformation temperature T and strain rate on the flow (rheological) stress.
applicability_conditions: Applied to the hot deformation of FeeMneAleC steel (and widely used in many studies); characterizes the combined effect of T and strain rate on rheological stress. The activation energy used in it is only the average value within the experimental range of this paper.

symbols.meaning: Zener–Hollomon parameter (temperature-compensated strain rate function) characterizing the comprehensive influence of temperature and strain rate

unmapped: The Z parameter increases with the increase of strain rate or the decrease of T, which is the same as that of the flow stress.

The Zener-Hollomon parameter helps construct the functional relationship between the characteristic values (critical strain/stress, peak strain/stress and steady-state strain/stress) of the flow stress curve and the Z parameter.
